Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) DeleteMediaObjectsBodyParams:
- filesToBeDeleted* object[] - Array of file objects to be deleted or trashed
  - _id* string (e.g. "686f630df0d3166d68fbcec2") - Unique identifier of the file or folder to be deleted
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Type of entity that owns the files
- altId* string (e.g. "sx6wyHhbFdRXh302LLNR") - Location identifier
- status* string (enum: deleted | trashed; e.g. "deleted") - Status to set for the files (deleted or trashed)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- (root) any

### Create Folder
POST /medias/folder
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/medias/folder
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/medias/create-media-folder | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/medias/create-media-folder.md

Creates a new folder in the media storage

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateFolderParams:
- altId* string (e.g. "sx6wyHhbFdRXh302LLNR") - Location Id
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Type of entity (location only)
- name* string (e.g. "New Folder") - Name of the folder to be created
- parentId string (e.g. "64af50c42d567a3b4f5989e0") - ID of the parent folder (optional)

Response 200 (Returns the newly created folder object) application/json:
- altId* string - Location identifier that owns this folder
- altType* string (enum: location) - Type of entity that owns the folder
- name* string - Name of the folder
- parentId string - ID of the parent folder (null for root folders)
- type* string - Type of the object (always 'folder' for folders)
- deleted boolean - Whether the folder has been deleted
- pendingUpload boolean - Whether there are pending uploads to this folder
- category string - Primary category of content stored in the folder
- subCategory string - Sub-category of content stored in the folder
- isPrivate boolean - Whether the folder is private and not publicly accessible
- relocatedFolder boolean - Whether the folder has been moved from its original location
- migrationCompleted boolean - Whether the data migration process has been completed for this folder
- appFolder boolean - Whether this is a system-generated application folder
- isEssential boolean - Whether the folder is essential and should not be deleted
- status string - Current status of the folder
- lastUpdatedBy string - ID of the user who last updated the folder

### Get List of Files/Folders
GET /medias/files
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/medias/files
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/medias/fetch-media-content | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/medias/fetch-media-content.md

Fetches list of files and folders from the media storage

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: medias.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- offset string (e.g. "5") - Number of files to skip in listing
- limit string (e.g. "10") - Number of files to show in the listing
- sortBy* string (e.g. "updatedAt") - Field to sorting the file listing by (e.g. updatedAt, name)
- sortOrder* string (e.g. "asc") - Direction in which file needs to be sorted
- type* string (e.g. "file") - Type
- query string (e.g. "Test file") - Query text
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - AltType
- altId* string - location Id
- parentId string - parent id or folder id
- fetchAll string (e.g. "false") - Fetch all files or folders

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- files* string[] - Array of File Objects

### Upload File into Media Storage
POST /medias/upload-file
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/medias/upload-file
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/medias/upload-media-content | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/medias/upload-media-content.md

If hosted is set to true then fileUrl is required. Else file is required. If adding a file, maximum allowed is 25 MB. For video files, the maximum allowed size is 500 MB.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: medias.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (multipart/form-data):
- file file
- hosted boolean
- fileUrl string
- name string
- parentId string

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- fileId* string - ID of the uploaded file
- url* string - Google Cloud Storage URL of the uploaded file
